text: {"danger_level":"red","danger_reason":"You are outdoors approximately 210 meters northeast of a reported car bomb explosion hazard.","main_move":"MOVE_AWAY","main_move_text":"Move away immediately from the suspect vehicle location and seek shelter behind heavy structures.","where_to_go":"Move away at least 300 to 500 meters northeast into a solid building, away from latitude 13.041, longitude 80.234.","do_now":[{"text":"Move away rapidly from the direction of the hazard.","advice_ids":["ADV_MOVE_AWAY"]},{"text":"Get behind solid concrete structures or walls for protection against blast debris.","advice_ids":["ADV_TAKE_COVER"]},{"text":"Cover your head and ears and stay low if you hear an explosion.","advice_ids":["ADV_PROTECT_SELF"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not approach or inspect the suspicious vehicle.","advice_ids":["ADV_DONOT_APPROACH"]},{"text":"Do not stand near glass windows, doors, or open areas.","advice_ids":["ADV_AVOID_GLASS"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"Outdoors on foot","text":"Walk quickly away from the blast area and take shelter inside a concrete building.","advice_ids":["ADV_OUTDOORS"]}],"call":["112","100"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"Coordinates for both person and disaster location are clear, indicating close proximity to a high hazard area.","unknowns":["Status of secondary explosive devices or official evacuation perimeter radius."],"valid_while":["Until local authorities clear the area and declare it safe."]}
